item.title: WBR Connect app resolves over 120 issues since launch
item.description: The WBR Connect app allows West Baton Rouge Parish residents to report non-emergency issues, such as potholes, broken playground equipment, and damaged fire hydrants, and receive real-time updates on their requests.

item.title: Eric Dane, 'Grey's Anatomy' star and ALS awareness advocate, dies at 53
item.description: Eric Dane, the celebrated actor best known for his roles on “Grey’s Anatomy” and “Euphoria” and who later in life became an advocate for ALS awareness, died Thursday. He was 53. His representatives said Dane died from amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, known also as Lou Gehrig’s disease, less than a year after he announced his diagnosis. [...]

item.description: American Cruise Lines reached a 20-year agreement with Baton Rouge to bring river ships back.

item.title: United States wins Olympic gold medal in women's hockey, defeating Canada 2-1
item.description: United States wins its third Olympic gold medal in women's hockey, beating Canada 2-1 on Megan Keller's goal in overtime.

item.title: 'Grey's Anatomy' star Eric Dane dies after ALS battle
item.description: Actor Eric Dane, best known for his role as Dr. Mark Sloan ("McSteamy") on ABC's "Grey's Anatomy" has died at the age of 53.

item.title: Alysa Liu wins first women's figure skating gold medal for the US in 24 years
item.description: Alysa Liu delivered the U.S. its first women’s figure skating Olympic gold medal in 24 years, performing a near-flawless free skate on Thursday night in a glittering golden dress to upstage Japanese rivals Kaori Sakamoto and Ami Nakai at the Milan Cortina Games.

item.title: EBR School Board clears up confusion on the site of a new school
item.description: The East Baton Rouge School Board is working to identify an architectural firm to design a new high school, while also addressing the potential impact of St. George becoming its own school district on the system's finances and students.
